name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Floating Footer Elevated Clearance: Elevated capsule dock with safe margins ensuring zero collision with Android 3-button navigation bar.
Search Studio Stacking Fix: Suggestions dropdown completely floats over category filter tabs and search cards with high z-index and hardware layering.
Vibrant Animated Abstract Mesh & Glassmorphism: Multi-color moving gradient meshes in Liquid Glass and Cyber Aurora Prism modes for cards and buttons.
Single File APK Overwrite: In-app APK updates cleanly overwrite and replace previous APK files in storage without creating duplicate (1).apk files.
